words.ex: a training method via Vision and Language knowledge Distillation
The fundamental challenge is the availability of training data
It is costly to further scale up the number of classes
To overcome this challenge, we propose ViLD
distills the knowledge from a pretrained open-vocabulary image classiﬁcation model (teacher)
use the teacher model to encode category texts and image regions
whose region embeddings of detected boxes are aligned
We benchmark on LVIS by holding out all rare categories
region embeddings with the text classiﬁer
ViLD has 3-6 AP gaps compared to the ﬁnetuning method
the LVIS-trained model with ResNet-50 backbone
